notes:
Summary: Mid-market product org (search + discovery product for e-commerce storefronts). Came in via inbound trial; strong interest in hosted API for quick POC, with conditional move to Dedicated for predictable latency and cost once rerank workload shows value. Primary evaluation focus: reranking endpoint (server-side reordering of top-K candidates) and robust offline scoring for model selection.

Background/context:
- Product: SaaS search + personalization for 120+ merchants; search queries drive conversion funnel.
- Pain: current reranker is brittle (hand-tuned features + logistic model); low velocity on tune cycles. Want ML-first reranking to improve MRR and CTR.
- Ops: engineering team of ~12 backend engineers; Product lead: Claire Nguyen (quoted: "we need predictable tail latency for live rerank, but offline evals first").

Meeting/timeline highlights (bulleted CRM-style):
- 2025-10-22: inbound signup, API key created, small smoke tests run.
- 2025-11-05: hosted API demo (ff_20251105_demo_parallax) — showed rerank endpoint and streaming. AE Marina + SE Ethan on call. Action: provide sample eval plan.
- 2025-12-08: security call — shared SOC2 checklist, legal asked about EU residency for EU merchants. Received security questionnaire v1 (drive link).
- 2026-01-12: POC kickoff — provided sample rerank sampling script and dataset template. POC target: run offline scoring on 10k query holdout, measure MRR@10, NDCG@10, latency distribution for hosted endpoint.
- 2026-02-15: internal demo of early offline scoring results (partial). Decided to test a quantized open model and Redwood-verified rerank profile side-by-side.
- 2026-02-20: health-check call (ff_20260112_poc_checkin). SE recommended Dedicated sizing if 95p latency for single-request rerank >200ms under expected qps.

POC details / technical requirements:
- Workload: server-side reranking of top-50 candidates per query, typical qps (live) 20-50 across tenants, peak bursts up to 150 qps. Offline scoring batch runs ~200k scoring jobs per day.
- Latency targets: 95th percentile <= 200ms for single-request rerank (live), p50 < 80ms.
- Throughput/cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; prefer hosted for quick iteration but want Dedicated price anchor for predictable unit cost at scale.
- Eval sets: agreed to run 10k-query holdout + 100k historical queries for offline scoring. Metrics: MRR@10, NDCG@10, pairwise win-rate vs. baseline.
- Model preferences: open to Llama-family fine-tuned reranker, quantized 8-bit model for Dedicated. Want Redwood recommendations on quantization vs. quality tradeoffs.
- Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to cheaper model variant during bursts and region-aware routing for EU merchants.

Security/compliance notes:
- Legal: EU data residency required for 30% of customers (need private tenancy / region-specific hosting).
- InfoSec: asked for KMS/HSM support and audit log retention options. SSO/SAML mandatory for admin console.

Commercials & pricing discussion:
- Interested in a path: start hosted API POC (low friction) -> Dedicated reserved pool (12–24 month commit) if ARR economics justify.
- Requested pricing scenarios: (a) hosted eval credits for POC, (b) 12-month Dedicated commitment with X GPUs equivalent and burst pricing. AE provided draft pricing (drive:/deals/parallax/2026-02-pricing-proposal.pdf).

Open items / next actions (short):
- SE to deliver eval script + example infra IaC for uploading eval sets (Ethan) — due 2026-03-05.
- Security to send completed SOC2 artifacts and KMS integration doc (Marina) — awaiting legal sign-off.
- AE to produce Dedicated sizing and committed pricing options after POC results (Marina) — target 2026-04.
- Customer to anonymize dataset and share 10k holdout by 2026-03-10.

Sales shorthand / voice notes (internal):
- "Good motion — product-led but willing to commit if we prove ROI via MRR uplift from rerank. Strong signal: they asked about Dedicated SLAs and EU residency early."
- Risk: dataset readiness and legal timeline are the gating factors. Pricing acceptable if committed unit cost beats current cloud ops.

Links: pricing deck (drive:/deals/parallax/2026-02-pricing-proposal.pdf), POC instructions (drive:/pocs/parallax/2026-01-eval-instructions.md), demo transcript (Fireflies ff_20251105_demo_parallax).
